name: Wormser Linux User Stammtisch (WoLUST)
description: monthly Linux regulars' table in Worms
note: German; first Tuesday of the month, next 5 Jan and 2 Feb
details:
Informal monthly meeting of Linux users in Worms. Topics are mostly free: current experiences from work, school or hobby projects with Linux; anyone interested in Linux can join the table.

Food and drinks are paid by each guest. Next dates after 1 Dec: Tue 5 Jan and Tue 2 Feb 2027, 19:30. The group also ran a Linux Presentation Day in Worms on 16 Oct 2026.
